profile.name: 侯柏超 (Rick Hou)
profile.title: Software Engineer | Backend-Focused Full-Stack Development | Enterprise Applications · Data Platforms · SCM Systems

about.title: About Me
about.content: I am a software engineer with around 5 years of experience in full-stack development, mainly focusing on backend systems. I have worked on enterprise applications including supply chain management systems, order and shipment workflows, and internal data platforms, with experience in Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. I am passionate about understanding how systems and business processes work, and I prefer to approach problems by first understanding the requirements and finding practical solutions. I am also interested in new technologies and willing to learn when they can help solve real-world problems.

content.summary: Responsible for developing internal supply chain management (SCM) systems and data service platforms, with a focus on backend development and experience in Java, Node.js, and full-stack integration.
list: Developed SCM system modules using Java / Spring Boot, covering order tracking, shipment processes, and production status management, helping systematize existing manual processes and improve operational efficiency.

Smart Shipment | Shipment Process Management System: Developed backend processes, reporting logic, and cross-system data integration for shipment workflows that previously required manual queries across SAP, MES, and inventory management systems; modified existing Airflow DAGs and applied Redis Distributed Lock to handle data synchronization and concurrent operations, supporting over 100 DN issuance requests per day.

Order Confirmation | Order Production Status Tracking System: Developed backend processes and integrated order, production, and material shortage data from different systems; separated business modules by brand and implemented data integrity checks, supporting the daily tracking of approximately 10,000–20,000 order statuses and reducing the generation time of certain reports from approximately 2 hours to 10–20 minutes.

Data Service Portal | Enterprise Data Service Platform: Participated in the design of data dictionary and data service management features, using Node.js, Angular, and PostgreSQL to develop frontend functions and integrate frontend and backend APIs, enabling centralized management of internal data services such as APIs, batch processes, and events.
Participated in requirements discussions and business scenario clarification, working with Tech Leads and users to translate business requirements into system features and processing workflows.
Participated in the development of EOM, a discontinued-part management process, handling BOM and material relationship logic, allocation logic, and reporting functions.

content.summary: Developed full-stack applications using Node.js (Express.js, Sails.js) and React, primarily for smart retail projects, while gaining experience across POS systems, competition scoring platforms, and event management applications.
list: Developed full-stack applications using Node.js (Express.js, Sails.js) and React, responsible for backend APIs, data processing, and frontend interfaces.

Vending Machine Sales Management System: Developed an operations management platform integrating transaction data and providing sales statistics, transaction history, and device status management to support the digitalization of smart retail operations.

Participated in projects including POS systems, competition scoring platforms, and event management websites, developing system features based on different business requirements and application scenarios.

Worked in a startup environment across the development lifecycle, from requirements discussions and system design to implementation and deployment, gaining experience translating business requirements into practical system functions.

content.workUnit: Testing Center for Technological and Vocational Education
list: Contributed to the development and maintenance of the Ministry of Education’s Senior Learning Website, including feature modifications, bug fixes, and basic system maintenance.
Adjusted user authentication flows to meet security requirements, gaining practical experience in maintaining and enhancing existing systems.
